shortDescription: Creation and management of Virtual I/O Server partition

options.name: action
options.description: C(install) install VIOS through NIM Server or disk. C(accept_license) Accept license after fresh installation of VIOS. C(copy) copies VIOS images from NFS/SFTP server to the HMC. C(delete) deletes VIOS images present in the HMC.

options.name: directory_list
options.description: The name of one or more VIOS installation images to remove

options.name: directory_name
options.description: The name to give the VIOS installation image on the HMC.

options.name: files
options.description: Specify one or two comma-separated VIOS ISO files. Required for remote imports ['sftp', 'nfs']; not valid for USB.

options.name: free_pvs
options.description: Provides the Unassigned Physical Volume details. Default value is False. Valid only for C(state) = I(facts)

options.name: hmc_auth
options.description: Username and Password credential of the HMC.

options.name: hmc_host
options.description: The IP Address or hostname of the HMC.

options.name: image_dir
options.description: This parameter determines whether to use the HMC based image for VIOS installation, rather than relying on the Network Installation Manager (NIM). Name of the directory on which VIOS image is available on HMC. This represent the same parameter C(directory_name) that is used during the copy action. valid only for C(action) = I(install)

options.name: label
options.description: Specifies a label name for installed vios to use instead of creating a default label name. supports only installation through image available on the HMC local disk. valid only for C(action) = I(install)

options.name: location_code
options.description: Network adapter location code to be used while installing VIOS through nim server. If user doesn't provide, it automatically picks the first pingable adapter attached to the partition. valid only for C(action) = I(install)

options.name: media
options.description: Media type for the VIOS installation (e.g., nfs, sftp).

options.name: mount_location
options.description: Required for VIOS image imports from NFS; specify the NFS server mount location.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the VirtualIOServer for installation through nim server or image available on HMC local disk.

options.name: network_macaddr
options.description: Specifies the client MAC address through which the network installation of the Virtual I/O Server will take place. If user doesn't provide, it automatically picks the first pingable adapter attached to the partition. valid only for C(action) = I(install)

options.name: nim_IP
options.description: This parameter determines whether to use Network Installation Manager (NIM) rather than relying on the HMC based image for VIOS installation. IP Address of the NIM Server. valid only for C(action) = I(install)

options.name: nim_gateway
options.description: VIOS gateway IP Address. valid only for C(action) = I(install) supports installation through nim server. This parameter is deprecated now and will be removed from future versions and as a replacement C(vios_gateway) can be used now onwards.

options.name: nim_subnetmask
options.description: Subnetmask IP Address to be configured to VIOS. valid only for C(action) = I(install) supports installation through nim server. This parameter is deprecated now and will be removed from future versions and as a replacement C(vios_subnetmask) can be used now onwards.

options.name: nim_vlan_id
options.description: Specifies the VLANID(0 to 4094) to use for tagging Ethernet frames during network install for virtual network communication. Default value is 0 valid only for C(action) = I(install)

options.name: nim_vlan_priority
options.description: Specifies the VLAN priority (0 to 7) to use for tagging Ethernet frames during network install for virtual network communication. Default value is 0 valid only for C(action) = I(install)

options.name: options
options.description: Specify options for the NFS mount command in double quotes. Default is version 3; use vers=4 for version 4. Valid only for VIOS image imports from NFS.

options.name: prof_name
options.description: Profile Name to be used for VIOS install. Default profile name 'default_profile'. valid only for C(action) = I(install)

options.name: remote_directory
options.description: Specify the directory on the remote server for the VIOS installation image. If not provided for SFTP, the user's home directory is used; for NFS, the mount location is used.

options.name: remote_server
options.description: The host name or IP address of the remote server ['sftp', 'nfs'].

options.name: settings
options.description: To configure various supported attributes of VIOS partition. Supports all the attributes available for creation of VIOS on the mksyscfg command except 'lpar_env'. valid only for C(state) = I(present)

options.name: sftp_auth
options.description: Username and Password credential of the SFTP Server.

options.name: ssh_key_file
options.description: Specify the SSH private key file name. If not fully qualified, it must be in the user's home directory on the HMC. This option is only valid for sftp and is mutually exclusive with password.

options.name: state
options.description: C(facts) fetch details of specified I(VIOS). C(present) creates VIOS with specified I(settings). C(listimages) list the VIOS images present in HMC

options.name: system_name
options.description: The name or mtms (machine type model serial) of the managed system.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Max waiting time in mins for VIOS to bootup fully. Min timeout should be more than 10 mins. Default value is 60 min. valid only for C(action) = I(install)

options.name: vios_IP
options.description: IP Address to be configured to VIOS. valid only for C(action) = I(install)

options.name: vios_gateway
options.description: VIOS gateway IP Address. valid only for C(action) = I(install) supports installation through nim server and image available on the HMC local disk.

options.name: vios_iso
options.description: The vios iso file to be installed. supports only installation through image available on the HMC local disk. valid only for C(action) = I(install)

options.name: vios_subnetmask
options.description: Subnetmask IP Address to be configured to VIOS. valid only for C(action) = I(install) supports installation through nim server and image available on the HMC local disk.

options.name: virtual_optical_media
options.description: Provides the virtual optical media details. Default value is False. Valid only for C(state) = I(facts)
